failOnErrors.description: An integer specifying the maximum number of errors that the service provider will accept before the operation is terminated and an error response is returned.

method.description: The HTTP method of the current operation.

path.description: The resource's relative path. If the method is POST, the value must specify a resource type endpoint, for example `/Users` or `/Groups`. All other method values must specify the path to a specific resource.

data.description: The Resource JSON data as it appears for a single POST or PATCH resource operation.

bulkId.description: The transient identifier of a newly created resource, unique within a bulk request and created by the client.

operations.description: Contains a list of bulk operations for POST/PATCH/DELETE operations.
